    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Substantially modifies src/rpc/node.cpp (+64/-25) to update the `logging` RPC interface to support trace categories and manage output deprecation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updates the `logging` RPC interface to expose trace categories while preserving compatibility via a deprecated output fallback. Deserves standard review for RPC schema consistency and deprecation hygiene, but does not address high-impact RPC bugs or critical compatibility breaks."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes in src/test/logging_tests.cpp, test/functional/feature_logging.py, and src/bench/logging.cpp test the logging subsystem directly.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Modifications update test coverage for the logging changes rather than improving shared test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Core changes reside in src/logging.cpp and src/logging.h, refactoring logging internals, configuration thread safety, and command-line arguments.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Replaces mutex-guarded category lookups with atomic bitmasks to make `ShouldDebugLog` and `ShouldTraceLog` lock-free on high-frequency paths, while making logger configuration access thread-safe. It also streamlines usability by replacing `-loglevel` with `-trace`, providing a clean and worthwhile performance and ergonomics improvement to shared logging primitives."
    },
